title: Open any file with Trillion
summary: Right-click any file on your Mac and choose Open With > Trillion: it lands in Message your AIs in the menu bar panel, ready to send with a note or your voice. A big file is kept in your Trillion files instead.

payload.title: Right-click, Open With, Trillion
payload.body: In Finder, right-click any file and choose Open With > Trillion, or drop it on Trillion in the Dock. The menu bar panel opens with the file in Message your AIs; add a few words or record your voice, then send. A file too big to send this way is kept in your Trillion files and the panel opens them.
